verdict.rationale: Bugbot supports delegating specific tasks — manually triggering AI reviews via PR comments and delegating fixes to Cursor's Cloud Agents via 'Fix in Cursor'/'Fix in Web' links — but it is a narrow, single-purpose review/fix agent rather than a general-purpose built-in assistant you can delegate arbitrary tasks to. missing for 10: evidence of open-ended task delegation beyond PR review/fix workflows, and a conversational/general-assistant interface within Bugbot itself.
